products.name: Apple iPhone 13 128GB
products.description: The iPhone 13 pairs a bright 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display with the fast A15 Bionic chip and a dual 12MP camera system. Unit is brand new, sealed, factory unlocked and ready for any Nigerian network. Box contents: iPhone, USB-C to Lightning cable, documentation.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy A55 5G 8/256GB
products.description: A dependable mid-ranger with a 6.6-inch 120Hz AMOLED screen, 50MP OIS camera and a 5,000mAh battery that easily lasts a full day. 8GB RAM with 256GB storage, dual-SIM 5G support and Samsung's four generations of Android updates.

products.name: Tecno Camon 30 8/256GB
products.description: Popular all-rounder with a 6.78-inch AMOLED display, 50MP selfie camera and 70W fast charging. Great value for everyday use, streaming and social media, with 8GB RAM (plus virtual expansion) and 256GB of storage.

products.name: Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 Pro 8/256GB
products.description: 200MP main camera, 6.67-inch AMOLED panel and 67W turbo charging at a price that makes sense. The battery comfortably covers a heavy day, and MIUI extras like split-screen make multitasking simple.

products.name: Apple MacBook Air 13-inch M2 8/256GB
products.description: Fanless, silent and seriously fast. The M2 MacBook Air handles coding, design, video calls and dozens of browser tabs while still returning all-day battery life. 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display, MagSafe charging and two Thunderbolt ports.

products.name: HP EliteBook 840 G8 i7/16/512
products.description: Business-class ultrabook: Intel Core i7, 16GB RAM and a fast 512GB NVMe SSD. Thin, light and built to survive daily commuting, with a comfortable backlit keyboard and a crisp 14-inch full-HD screen. Excellent for office work and remote roles.

products.name: Dell Latitude 5420 i5/16/512
products.description: Reliable 14-inch workhorse with an 11th-gen Intel Core i5, 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD. Fast boot, excellent keyboard and all the ports you need (HDMI, USB-C, USB-A). A smart pick for students, developers and business users.

products.name: Apple AirPods Pro 2 USB-C
products.description: Active noise cancellation that genuinely works on Lagos traffic, Adaptive Transparency, and a battery case with Find My support. Sweat and water resistant, with personalised spatial audio for movies and music.

products.name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones
products.description: Among the best noise-cancelling headphones you can buy: eight microphones, 30-hour battery life and superb call quality. Light on the head, folds flat, and pairs with two devices at once so you can switch between laptop and phone.

products.name: JBL Flip 6 Bluetooth Speaker
products.description: Pocket-sized speaker with surprisingly big sound, IP67 waterproof/dustproof rating and 12 hours of playtime. Pair two Flip 6 speakers for stereo sound at events, or use it as a loud speakerphone at the desk.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 44mm
products.description: Sleek smartwatch with a crisp Super AMOLED display, sleep and heart-rate tracking, GPS and 40+ workout modes. Works with any recent Android phone and easily lasts a day and a half on a charge.

products.name: Anker 737 PowerBank 24,000mAh 140W
products.description: High-capacity power bank with a 140W USB-C port that can charge a MacBook, plus a smart digital display showing remaining time. Charges itself fully in about an hour. Cabin-friendly and built for blackouts.
